decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the firm's established offer and kept its own page through 2024 in a growing industry, so it meets the aspiration level and needs no problemistic search, while slack from a broad portfolio lets the firm carry it.

The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer and has a documented customer installation combining creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, which supports keeping it even though its web presence is only a mention.
